definitions.explanation: The activity of catching fish, typically with a rod and line. A popular recreational activity in Japan.
The money returned when you pay more than the price. Written as お{釣|つ}り in this meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{釣|つ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: Do you prefer sea fishing or river fishing?
examples.notes: Note: 釣り becomes づり in compounds

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{釣|つ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{釣|つ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦ようです→ようだ：26593_youda⟧。
examples.english: It seems the change is short.

examples.japanese: ⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}ったら→払う：00535_harau⟧、⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{釣|つ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三百円|さんびゃくえん}→三百円：noentry⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I paid with a thousand yen, the change was three hundred yen.

notes:
USAGE: {釣|つ}り has two distinct meanings: (1) fishing and (2) change (money). The context usually makes the meaning clear.

FISHING-RELATED WORDS:
・{釣|つ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go fishing)
・⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧{釣|づ}り (sea fishing)
・⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧{釣|づ}り (river fishing)
・⟦{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}→釣り竿：07331_tsurizao⟧ (fishing rod)
・⟦{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}→釣り針：28211_tsuribari⟧ (fishhook)
・⟦{釣|つ}り{人|びと}→釣り人：27614_tsuribito⟧ (angler, fisherman)
・⟦{釣|つ}り{堀|ぼり}→釣り堀：27615_tsuribori⟧ (fishing pond)

MONEY-RELATED:
・⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{釣|つ}り (change - always with お)
・⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{釣|つ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive change)

Note: The verb form ⟦{釣|つ}る→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧ means both 'to fish' and 'to lure/entice'.
